newsitem.title: USA: Clinton projected to win Ohio -- TV networks.
newsitem.headline: Clinton projected to win Ohio -- TV networks.

text.p: President Bill Clinton has won the crucial Midwestern swing state of Ohio in the U.S. election, according to projections by the NBC, ABC and CNN television networks on Tuesday.

A Clinton victory in Ohio, which has 21 of the 270 electoral college votes needed to win the presidency, would be a blow to Republican nominee Bob Dole because no Republican has ever won the presidency without carrying the state.
